card.name: Hedges before fatal or severe outcomes
card.fires_on: Hedging or linking words that sit just before a severe outcome such as fatal, death, or hospitalization in warning text. Examples are sometimes, in some cases, at times, may, occasionally.

modes.label: Frequency hedge
modes.description: Words like sometimes, times, occasionally that soften a claim before fatal or serious outcomes.
modes.example: rare,<< sometimes>> fatal, cases of severe hepatic injury

modes.label: Linking word in a warning
modes.description: A comma, may, or or that connects a serious condition to its outcome.
modes.example: If a serious infection develops<<,>> interrupt ACTEMRA until the infection is

modes.label: In some cases
modes.description: The word cases after in some, leading into fatal.
modes.example: Hepatotoxicity may be severe, and in some<< cases>>, fatal.

card.writes: It lowers intensifiers like very and extremely, so the next word is a plain severity term such as fatal rather than an intensified one.
card.plain: It fires on small hedge words in safety warnings just before a word like fatal or death.
